item.text:
**7B.10 Research Note**

Bottom line: **mostly no**. Abiy Ahmed’s 2024 record contains some real technocratic and procedural positives, especially in macroeconomic reform and formal transitional-justice planning, but the stronger evidence points to selective repression, information control, denial in the face of abuses, and state-asset bargaining that erode public trust and normalize cynicism.

**Accepted Claims**

- **[E0523] Ethiopia’s leader plays down fears of conflict with Somalia over a planned naval port** | **Associated Press via CityNews** | **2024-02-06** | https://kitchener.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/ | Claim: Abiy publicly denied war intent and framed peace with Somalia as mutually beneficial. This is a limited positive signal for truthful public messaging and public trust, though it does not offset later coercive behavior. | **QIDs:** 7B.10; 7B.8

- **[E0556] Ethiopia discussing selling 10% stake in Ethio Telecom via stock exchange, Abiy says** | **Reuters** | **2024-02-20** | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Ethiopia-discussing-selling-10-stake-in-Ethio-Telecom-via-stock-exchange-Abiy-says-45989643/ | Claim: the government moved a major state asset toward a public stock-exchange sale rather than using it as an opaque political vehicle. This is weak-to-moderate anti-patronage evidence. | **QIDs:** 7B.10; 7B.9

- **[E0347] Council of Ministers approved draft NBE proclamation and banking business proclamation** | **National Bank of Ethiopia** | **2024-06-14** | https://nbe.gov.et/nbe_news/the-council-of-ministers-today-approved-the-draft-nbe-proclamation-and-banking-business-proclamation/ | Claim: the draft laws were framed as strengthening credibility, accountability, transparency, and governance in the central bank and banking sector. This supports a technocratic, less patronage-driven reading. | **QIDs:** 7B.10; 7B.9

- **[E0595] IMF Executive Board Completes the First Review under the Extended Credit Facility Arrangement for Ethiopia** | **International Monetary Fund** | **2024-10-18** | https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/10/18/pr-24383-ethiopia-imf-completes-the-1st-review-under-the-ecf-arrangement | Claim: Ethiopia met all quantitative performance criteria and most structural benchmarks under the IMF program. That is strong formal evidence of commitment-keeping in the macroeconomic domain. | **QIDs:** 7B.10; 7B.9

- **[E0596] Ethiopian Justice Minister Briefs Diplomats about Transitional Justice Policy Implementation** | **ENA English** | **2024-12-14** | https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5626876 | Claim: the government publicly framed transitional justice around accountability, truth-seeking, conditional amnesty, reconciliation, and institutional reform. This is the clearest pro-accountability official statement, but it remains roadmap rhetoric. | **QIDs:** 7B.10; 7B.6; 7B.7

- **[E0616] World Report 2024: Ethiopia** | **Human Rights Watch** | **2024-01-12** | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/ethiopia | Claim: HRW said a coordinated aid-diversion scheme forced WFP and USAID to halt food aid, suggesting politicized handling of a core welfare channel and possible capture by state actors. | **QIDs:** 7B.10; 7B.9

- **[E0575] Ethiopia: Authorities must stop using state of emergency law to silence peaceful dissent** | **Amnesty International** | **2024-02-19** | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/ethiopia-authorities-must-stop-using-state-of-emergency-law-to-silence-peaceful-dissent/ | Claim: emergency powers were used to detain politicians and journalists, impose curfews, restrict movement, and ban assemblies. This normalizes coercive rule over open civic life. | **QIDs:** 7B.10; 7B.6; 7B.7; 7B.9

- **[E0583] In Ethiopia, a secret committee orders killings and arrests to crush rebels** | **Ethiopian Human Rights Commission / Reuters** | **2024-02-27** | https://ehrc.org/in-ethiopia-a-secret-committee-orders-killings-and-arrests-to-crush-rebels-reuters/ | Claim: the EHRC head confirmed a secret Koree Nageenyaa committee interfered in the justice system, implying covert power insulated from normal oversight. | **QIDs:** 7B.10; 7B.6; 7B.7; 7B.9

- **[E0601] Ethiopia rejects allegations its forces massacred civilians as the West urges an investigation** | **Associated Press** | **2024-02-15** | https://toronto.citynews.ca/2024/02/15/ethiopia-rejects-allegations-its-forces-massacred-civilians-as-the-west-urges-an-investigation/ | Claim: officials denied Merawi massacre allegations despite contrary reporting and calls for investigation, which reads as obfuscation rather than candid accountability. | **QIDs:** 7B.10; 7B.7

- **[E0585] Ethiopia authorities suspend three rights groups** | **Human Rights Watch** | **2024-12-02** | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups | Claim: Abiy praised reform rhetoric while the government suspended rights groups, a sharp rhetoric-versus-practice gap that weighs against ethical public leadership. | **QIDs:** 7B.10; 7B.6; 7B.7; 7B.9

- **[E0618] Ethiopia: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report** | **Freedom House** | **2024** | https://freedomhouse.org/country/ethiopia/freedom-net/2024 | Claim: authorities restricted mobile internet, disrupted access during fighting, and used emergency powers to detain journalists without charge; the report also describes online manipulation and propaganda tactics. This is strong evidence for information control and degraded public trust. | **QIDs:** 7B.10; 7B.6; 7B.7; 7B.9

- **[E0615] Landlocked Ethiopia signs pact to use Somaliland’s Red Sea port** | **Reuters** | **2024-01-01** | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Landlocked-Ethiopia-signs-pact-to-use-Somaliland-s-Red-Sea-port-45654814/ | Claim: the Berbera MOU linked port access to possible recognition, naval use, and stakes in state-run companies, which looks like leverage-seeking state-asset bargaining rather than neutral public administration. | **QIDs:** 7B.10; 7B.9

- **[E0600] Ethiopia’s PM defends currency float amid inflation concerns** | **Reuters** | **2024-08-02** | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Ethiopia-s-PM-defends-currency-float-amid-inflation-concerns-47541564/ | Claim: Abiy refused to call the exchange-rate move a devaluation and instead reframed it as closing the official-black-market gap. This is defensive reframing, not a candid disclosure of tradeoffs. | **QIDs:** 7B.10; 7B.9

**Search Gap**

- I found **little direct 2024 evidence of family nepotism or personal financial self-enrichment** in the narrow sense.
- The stronger record is indirect but substantial: **loyalty-heavy security governance, secret parallel structures, aid diversion/capture, selective punishment of watchdogs, and public information manipulation**.
- That pattern is enough to weigh **against** an ethical, trust-building model even where Abiy’s government also advanced real technocratic reforms in finance and transitional justice.
